sections.title: Sensible names first
body: Selection components look for label, value, icon, children and snippet by default. If your data already uses those names, there is nothing to configure.

sections.title: Strings, dot-paths or functions
body: When it doesn’t, map the roles to your fields. A mapping can be a field name, a dot-path into nested data, or a function computed from the raw item.

sections.title: Resolved once, read cheaply
body: Every mapping is turned into a resolver function when the item is wrapped, so reading a field never branches on its type. Missing segments in a dot-path resolve to undefined instead of throwing.

sections.title: A smaller surface to review
body: A fields object is a few declarative lines. That is far easier to review than a generated adapter layer, and it keeps the original data intact.
